questions.text: What is the name of Ash's yellow electric Pokémon partner?
What Japanese word is used for comics and graphic novels from Japan?
What sport is the anime "Slam Dunk" about?
In Pokémon, what red-and-white device is thrown to catch a Pokémon?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Pokeball, ball.

questions.text: Doraemon is a blue robot shaped like what animal?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: pusa. He is a robot cat from the 22nd century.

questions.text: What is the name of the main Saiyan hero of "Dragon Ball"?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Son Goku, Kakarot.

questions.text: In "Dragon Ball", how many Dragon Balls must be gathered to summon the wish-granting dragon?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: 7. The dragon is Shenron.

questions.text: In "One Piece", what does Monkey D. Luffy dream of becoming?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Pirate King.

questions.text: Naruto Uzumaki is a ninja from which hidden village?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Konoha, Konohagakure, Leaf Village.

questions.text: In the Filipino dub of "Ghost Fighter", what is the name of the main hero?
questions.hostNotes: In the Japanese original, he is Yusuke Urameshi.

questions.text: What 1970s super robot anime, pulled off Philippine TV in 1979, got a live-action remake in 2023?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Voltes Five, Voltes V: Legacy. The remake aired on GMA.

questions.text: In "Demon Slayer", what is the name of the boy whose sister Nezuko is turned into a demon?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Tanjiro Kamado.

questions.text: In "Attack on Titan", humanity lives inside giant what to protect itself from the Titans?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: pader. The three walls are Maria, Rose and Sina.

questions.text: Which Studio Ghibli film features a giant furry forest spirit and a Catbus?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Totoro, Tonari no Totoro.

questions.text: What is the name of the boy detective shrunk by a poison in "Detective Conan"?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Conan, Shinichi Kudo (his real identity).

questions.text: What is the name of Goku's signature energy-blast attack in "Dragon Ball"?
What is the name of the lazy boy whom Doraemon helps with gadgets?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Nobita Nobi.

questions.text: "Ghost Fighter" is the Filipino dub of which Japanese anime?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: YuYu Hakusho, Yu Yu.

questions.text: In "Slam Dunk", what is the name of the red-haired delinquent who joins the basketball team?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Sakuragi, Hanamichi.

questions.text: What creature is sealed inside Naruto's body?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Kurama, Kyuubi, Nine-Tails.

questions.text: What is the name of the main character of "Attack on Titan"?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Eren, Eren Jaeger.

questions.text: In Pokémon, what is the name of Ash's hometown?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Pallet.

questions.text: In "Death Note", what is the name of the student who finds the notebook that kills?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Light, Kira. Not L, the detective hunting him.

questions.text: In "One Piece", what Devil Fruit did Luffy eat to gain his rubber powers?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Gomu Gomu no Mi. Late in the story it is revealed as the Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika; accept that too.

questions.text: Which Studio Ghibli film follows a girl named Chihiro who works in a bathhouse for spirits?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Sen to Chihiro no Kamikakushi.

questions.text: Which Japanese director co-founded Studio Ghibli and made "Spirited Away"?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Miyazaki.

questions.text: In "Voltes V", who is the leader of the team and pilot of the Volt In?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Steve. In the Japanese original he is Kenichi Go.

questions.text: In "Bleach", what is the name of the orange-haired teen who becomes a Soul Reaper?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Ichigo.

questions.text: What are the first names of the two alchemist brothers in "Fullmetal Alchemist"?
questions.hostNotes: Both names needed. Also accept: Ed and Al. Their surname is Elric.

questions.text: In "Jujutsu Kaisen", whose cursed fingers does Yuji Itadori swallow?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Sukuna, King of Curses.

questions.text: What is the name of Goku's second son?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Son Goten. Not Gohan, his first son.

questions.text: In "Naruto", which clan does Sasuke belong to?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Uchiha clan.

questions.text: What two words is the name "Pokémon" short for?
In "Death Note", what fruit does the shinigami Ryuk love to eat?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: apple, mansanas.

questions.text: What Japanese term is used for manga and anime aimed at teenage boys?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: shonen. Not shōjo, which targets girls.

questions.text: Which manga artist created "Dragon Ball"?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Toriyama. He also created "Dr. Slump".

questions.text: Which manga artist created "One Piece"?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Oda.

questions.text: In "Slam Dunk", what is the name of the high school whose basketball team the series follows?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Shohoku High.

questions.text: What was the name of the Straw Hat Pirates' first ship in "One Piece"?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Merry, Merry Go. Not the Thousand Sunny, their second ship.

questions.text: In the Filipino dub of "Ghost Fighter", what name was given to the fire demon Hiei?
questions.hostNotes: The others: Yusuke is Eugene, Kuwabara is Alfred, Kurama is Dennis.

questions.text: In "Voltes V", what is the name of the Boazanian prince who leads the invasion of Earth?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Zardoz. In the Japanese original he is Prince Heinel.

questions.text: Which Pokémon is number 001 in the National Pokédex?
questions.hostNotes: Not Pikachu, which is number 025.

questions.text: In "Hunter x Hunter", Killua comes from what famous family of assassins?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Zoldyck family, Zaoldyeck.

questions.text: Who is the teenage pilot of Evangelion Unit-01 in "Neon Genesis Evangelion"?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Shinji.

questions.text: What 1988 Studio Ghibli film follows two orphaned siblings in Japan near the end of World War II?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Hotaru no Haka. Directed by Isao Takahata.
